dataset.name: A.E.S.I.R. War-Systems Council geopolitical forecast dataset
dataset.current_retrieval_limit: The Codex read_thread preview exposed bounded and partly truncated message text. Full-fidelity ingestion requires an official ChatGPT export JSON/ZIP or an Athena audited JSONL source file.

classification_policy.cited factual claims: reported until independently verified against cited primary or reliable sources

evidence_boundaries.fact: Only promote as fact after a direct source, file hash, command output, or separately verified citation supports it.
evidence_boundaries.inference: Promote as inference when it follows from recorded evidence but is not directly observed.
evidence_boundaries.hypothesis: Store scenario logic and causal possibilities as research hypotheses, not memory facts.
evidence_boundaries.forecast: Store probabilities and timelines as dated forecasts with evidence cutoff and review date.

promotion_targets.promotion_rule: Dated claims, uncertainty, contradictions, and evidence links.
Processed outputs using verified, plausible, speculative, contradicted, or needs-test labels.
Scenario hypotheses and forecast review tasks.
Only durable process lessons, not raw geopolitical assertions.

run_sequence: Confirm source scope is this single conversation id.
Run a dry import and verify coverage is one conversation with nonzero messages.
Run the write import to create an ignored local source bundle.
Review normalized messages and mark incomplete or truncated source gaps.
Create proposed promotion records for facts, inferences, hypotheses, and forecasts.
Verify claims before any canonical fact writeback.
Run repository validation and, for broader changes, the operation cycle.
